description: Closed generic projection/accepted-delta rules for normalizing research observation results across Python and TypeScript engines. Replace run-local IDs with first-appearance ordinal tokens, sort identity arrays/maps bytewise, omit timestamps/latency/cost, and hash the language-neutral result payload.

normalization_rules.id_replacement: Replace every run-local ID (run_id, session_id, receipt_id, artifact_id, branch_id) with a first-appearance ordinal token: <ID_0>, <ID_1>, ...
normalization_rules.array_sorting: Sort all identity-bearing arrays and map keys bytewise (UTF-8) before hashing

accepted_deltas.reason: Python=python, TypeScript=typescript; this is the expected difference, not a parity mismatch
Receipt IDs are engine-generated and replaced by ordinal tokens; equality is on the normalized projection
Artifact IDs are content-addressed and may differ if the same content is stored under different runs; the content_digest must match
